title: Review Rerun camera frustum fix
objective: Review the Builder changes for the programmatic flashlight Rerun stream, focusing on coordinate conversion, camera/frustum entity paths, image color handling, and validation gaps.
instructions: Review the current changes against the user request: world-frame camera view, visible frustum/image projection, and sane image colors.
Check whether the Unreal-to-Rerun coordinate conversion and meter scaling are internally consistent for camera pose, trajectory, and light direction.
Check whether streams under spear/camera are likely to attach to the Rerun pinhole as intended.
Check color-model handling for rgb, world_normal_visualization, and diffuse_color_visualization.
constraints: Do not modify files; report findings only.
Do not run live simulator-dependent commands.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with review findings ordered by severity and specific file/line references where possible.
definition_of_done: Review result clearly says whether changes are acceptable or need Builder follow-up.
